name: Skyrim Together Reborn
author: Tilted Phoques
description: Multiplayer for Skyrim Special Edition, started from its own launcher.
curator_note: Checked on 2026-11-08 against release 1.8.4. Each release ships two Windows builds: SkyrimTogether-<version>-windows-x64.zip for Skyrim Special Edition 1.7.104 on Steam and GOG (the project's main target), and SkyrimTogether-<version>-windows-x64-sse1.6.1170.zip for 1.6.1170 on Steam and 1.6.1179 on GOG. Sources: kSupportedGameVersions in Code/client/main.cpp (index 1 Steam, 2 GOG) and the skyrim_version option in xmake.lua and .github/workflows/release.yml, all at https://github.com/tiltedphoques/TiltedEvolution. It has its own launcher (SkyrimTogether.exe) and needs Address Library; it does not need SKSE. Neither pattern matches a debug-symbols asset, and the 1.7.104 pattern does not match the 1.6.1170 build.
